# Device AI Continuum instructions for code-generation assistants
Read the repository-root `AGENTS.md`, `docs/CONTINUUM-EXPERIMENTVERTRAG.md` and `docs/CONTINUUM-EXPERIMENTE.json` **before producing or applying source edits**. The project is Android-first: build and validate APKs on the Android phone itself; optional external build workers must not become a dependency. Reuse the existing verified Git/repair/backlog/evidence pipeline. New infrastructure must preserve future experimental adapters (EXP-00 to EXP-12) without speculative feature creep. Never interpret a mock check as a real phone build; never auto-install or merge to main. Report reproducible evidence, tested commits and missing device capabilities.


## Mandatory JARVIS owner-governed research charter (EXP-16..23)
Before editing Jarvis, on-device cognition, neural training, local repair, identity, endpoint sync or thermal workers, read `docs/research/jarvis/JARVIS-OWNER-RESILIENCE-AND-NEURODYNAMICS-20261030.md` and the registered EXP-16 through EXP-23 entries. Treat HDC, tensor networks, zero-knowledge proofs, CTRNN, EWC and STDP as *unproven optional experiments*, never installed features. Existing `CognitiveGenome.allowSelfReplication=false`, `allowHiddenPersistence=false`, `allowShutdownEvasion=false` are non-negotiable. Owner can stop, revoke, unlink, wipe, and decline recovery. No hidden survival mechanisms, kill-switch bypass, automatically generated alternate privileged network routes, autonomous model-weight promotions or production merges. All adaptive code stays isolated and review-only. Retain one canonical Continuum brain, existing ToolGate, bounded test executor, failure receipts, offline handling, exact tested commit and Fold7 evidence gate.
